771eb742ce6b11f5be89f76e3e5ef1272fe99750.name: Earth Company Presents Re: Bali 2026
771eb742ce6b11f5be89f76e3e5ef1272fe99750.description: On Saturday, 28 November 2026, Earth Company is set to host Re: Bali 2026 at venue partner Mana Earthly Paradise, Ubud. Themed “Inner to Outer Regeneration”, this year’s event will run from 12pm to 6pm. A social enterprise based in Bali and Japan, Earth Company aims to develop regenerative futures that holistically enhance planetary well-being through three programmes: Impact Heroes – an accelerator programme empowering unique changemakers from the Asia-Pacific in shaping regenerative futures; Impact Academy – a transformative experiential programme that empowers institutions, companies and schools to build regenerative futures; and Mana Earthly Paradise – an award-winning next-generation eco-villa in Ubud that embodies circularity and regeneration. Following its debut last year – which drew over 100 participants and more than 60 organisations and social enterprises – Re: Bali shifts its focus to the people driving the work. This edition asks what regeneration demands of the people and organisations working for the island. At Earth Company, regeneration starts within. Grounded, supported, and connected changemakers create lasting impact across their communities and Bali’s environment.

659c2d7dbd09ad8aecad6e451f50231f70a39826.name: Sheraton Bali Kuta Resort Presents Finish-Line Maxxing Run &More
659c2d7dbd09ad8aecad6e451f50231f70a39826.description: On Sunday, 22 November 2026, Sheraton Bali Kuta Resort will gather Bali’s running community, hotel guests and local residents as they present Finish-Line Maxxing Run &More. The event combines active lifestyle, local culinary experiences, sustainable craftsmanship and community giving. Finish-Line Maxxing Run &More welcomes amateur to experienced runners to join a fun 5K social run , followed by a Coffee Rave Party at &More by Sheraton . Collaborating with the Erez Enterprize Community, the event will see up to 100 participants on a morning that combines running, coffee, food and music. In addition to the gathering, the activation is organised to support a neighbouring elementary school in Legian through a clothing donation initiative and to showcase gift bags created from repurposed hotel linen in collaboration with Tarum Bali and local artisans. Finish-LineMaxxing taps into Indonesia’s growing run club trend, and instead of establishing new running groups, Sheraton hotels decide to partner with existing clubs, turning the post-run cooldown into a social gathering focused on recovery and coffee culture. Hosted by Mika Affandy and Dominic Hulme , the morning commences with a casual 5K social run through Kuta and Legian starting at 6am , before reconvening at the resort for a post-run gathering until 10am .

5ab53ecef3f858ae33528468b77bde19108ebb8e.name: Beautiverse 2026: Green Beauty for the Future of Wellbeing
5ab53ecef3f858ae33528468b77bde19108ebb8e.description: From 18-20 December, Beautiverse 2026 returns to Bali, once again taking place at The Meru Sanur – Bali Beach Convention Centre, under the theme ‘Green Beauty for the Future of Wellbeing.’ This year, Beautiverse explores the evolution of the beauty industry towards a more holistic, conscious, and technology-driven approach. Over the three-day event, visitors can experience brand showcases, expert-led discussions, networking opportunities, and curated activities. The event also provides a platform for industry stakeholders to exchange ideas, build partnerships, and explore new opportunities across the beauty and wellness sectors. Featuring AI Ambassadors Tara, Bea, and Vexa as key highlights, Beautiverse introduces an innovative digital dimension to the experience. Beyond engaging audiences, these digital ambassadors reflect the growing relationship between artificial intelligence and the beauty and wellness industries. The Beautiverse App complements this initiative by providing information on the event, participating brands, programmes, and activities, creating a more interactive experience for visitors.

7b867e7d457fc4d9a977dc6058e28dc97a46a855.name: Padma Musical Series: George Harliono & Hera Hyesang Park
7b867e7d457fc4d9a977dc6058e28dc97a46a855.description: The Padma Musical Series returns this December with an evening of classical music featuring two acclaimed international artists: British-Indonesian pianist George Harliono and Korean soprano Hera Hyesang Park. Returning to Bali following his previous appearance at Padma Resort Legian, Harliono has established an impressive international career from a remarkably young age. In 2023, he received the Silver Medal at the XVII International Tchaikovsky Competition, one of the most prestigious events in the classical music world. His performance history includes celebrated venues such as Wigmore Hall, Royal Albert Hall, Berlin Philharmonie Kammermusiksaal and Suntory Hall, alongside appearances with orchestras including the NHK Symphony Orchestra, Tokyo Philharmonic Orchestra and Mariinsky Orchestra. Joining him for the December performance is Hera Hyesang Park, making her Bali debut. A Deutsche Grammophon recording artist and graduate of The Juilliard School, the Korean soprano has performed at leading opera houses and concert halls around the world, including the Metropolitan Opera, Staatsoper Berlin, Paris Opéra and Glyndebourne Festival. Her repertoire spans celebrated works including La bohème , La traviata , Don Giovanni and Le nozze di Figaro . Her debut album, I Am Hera , was released in 2020, followed by Breathe , which received the 2024 Opus Klassik Award for Videoclip of the Year.

When it comes to food, there is a common thread shared universally: it tells the story of place, its people, and the traditions passed down through generations. In Bali, culinary heritage is deeply rooted in local ingredients, age-old cooking methods, and knowledge preserved within village communities.
